images.policy: Only existing GUIDE_IMAGES keys used; original captions, author credit, license and source links remain in their media definitions. Photographs are location context or dated archival images, never represented as this year's event.
images.limitations: Small-city event venues and the four new storefronts did not have verified matching existing photographs. Explicit editorial illustrations were selected rather than another city's photo. train is a Santa Clara station image, not Levi's Stadium. region-stanford-quad is campus context, not a football-game image. Library notices with city scenery retain their original location captions.
images.recommendedAcquisition: If replacing fallbacks, acquire a correctly identified photograph through Wikimedia Commons with a specific file-page author/license review or obtain explicit reuse permission for official press photographs. No unverified press image or logo is treated as freely reusable.
